digest.component_or_area: rebar LLM class config schema and resolver
propositions: Add three config slots (trivial, standard, frontier) each accepting model, provider, endpoint, and an optional fallback array, parsed from the existing layered config precedence (CLI > env > file > default).
Expose a resolver mapping a class name to a provider-qualified model string, reusing infer_provider when provider is omitted so bare model ids behave as today.
When a slot is unset, defaults resolve to today's values (frontier claude-opus-4-8, standard claude-sonnet-4-6, trivial claude-haiku-4-5) preserving current behaviour bit-for-bit.
A slot or fallback entry containing api_key is rejected loudly as a typed config error, keeping secrets env-only.

The fallback array is parsed and validated to the slot-minus-fallback schema and carried on the resolved record but not consumed at runtime (deferred to sibling task cc33); it is non-recursive and config-file-only.
docs/env-vars.md must be regenerated and committed listing the nine new per-field env vars so the drift gate produces no diff on re-run.
